body:
TUNGSTEN - THE COMPOUNDING MATHS, COMPLETE (WARRANT#481-489, 2026-09-05)

===============================================================================
1. THE UNIFIED SYSTEM - ALL CONFIDENCE BANDS RUN TOGETHER AS ONE BOOK (#481)
===============================================================================
Manuel's architecture, and it works. Full signal density (STRIDE=1), the WARRANT#474 deep
champion model (400 iters, depth 6), leave-one-instrument-out across five FX pairs, each band
carrying its OWN bracket and its OWN Kelly stake on one sequential account.

  band          bracket        trades   /day    win%    fair     lift    stake
  top  0-2%     TP6.0/SL6.0      8116   17.2   56.5%   50.0%  +12.99%    1.93%
  top  2-5%     TP4.0/SL6.0     12895   27.4   65.7%   60.0%   +9.56%    2.03%
  top  5-10%    TP4.0/SL6.0     21626   45.9   64.1%   60.0%   +6.81%    1.27%
  top 10-15%    TP5.0/SL6.0     21519   45.7   58.0%   54.5%   +6.30%    0.84%
  top 15-20%    TP5.0/SL6.0     21485   45.6   57.5%   54.5%   +5.44%    0.62%
  85,641 signals = 181.9/day over ~471 trading days. LIFT IS MONOTONE ACROSS BANDS.

WARRANT#471 tried this and LOST ($222 vs $255) because band win rates zigzagged. WARRANT#474
fixed the ordering, so banding now works where it previously failed.

With the stake SOLVED so realised drawdown lands ON the 40% survival allowance (rather than
being reported wherever it fell):
  cap N   scalar   taken   /day    win%   terminal    CAGR   maxDD   250d $100
  10       0.444   13267   28.2   58.3%      4.89x   +134%   40.0%        $234
  20       0.427   25217   53.5   59.2%       26x    +473%   40.0%        $573
  30       0.314   36236   76.9   59.5%       34x    +563%   40.0%        $663
  50       0.244   54382  115.5   59.6%       70x    +869%   40.0%        $969
  80       0.186   71645  152.1   60.0%      120x   +1198%   40.0%      $1,298

BANDING BEATS THE BEST SINGLE CUT 4x ($1,298 vs $325) AT LOWER DRAWDOWN.
With drawdown pinned, MORE CONCURRENCY IS STRICTLY BETTER - diversification converts breadth
into return at constant risk.

===============================================================================
2. MULTI-UNIT ENTRY ON THE TOP BANDS - ISOLATED, AND IT IS MARGINAL (#483)
===============================================================================
Manuel asked for multiple trades at entry on the 2% and 5% bands. Tested against a FLAT null
hypothesis, every profile solved to the SAME 40% drawdown so only the ladder differs:

  FLAT       1/1/1/1/1   152.1/day  60.0%   $1,306
  MANUEL     3/2/1/1/1   152.1/day  60.0%   $1,299
  STEEP      4/3/2/1/1   152.1/day  60.0%   $1,327   <- best, +2%
  TOP-HEAVY  6/3/1/0/0    88.0/day  63.1%     $799   <- -39%, frequency thrown away
  MID-HEAVY  1/3/3/2/1   152.1/day  60.0%   $1,206

VERDICT: worth ~2%. The per-band Kelly stakes ALREADY encode the ladder, so multiplying on top
re-spends the same risk budget. Shipped STEEP because it is free, but it is not the lever.

===============================================================================
3. THE CEILING IS CAPACITY, NOT EDGE (#484/#485)
===============================================================================
12-year Monte Carlo, 4000 paths, EACH DRAWING ITS OWN TRUE WIN RATE from the sampling
distribution (the backtest MEASURED 60.4%, it did not observe it).

  year 1 median $1.78k | yr2 $31.8k | yr3 $571k | yr4 $9.16M
  yr5 $12.44M | yr6 $12.60M | yr7 $12.60M | ... | yr12 $12.59M   <- FROZEN

Growth is 18.0x/yr and then STOPS DEAD. Win rate is unchanged - the account's own orders become
large enough to move the price it trades against, and a percentage edge stops being a percentage.

THE THREE NUMBERS THAT MATTER:
  $6.32M   erosion begins - largest account still trading at full edge
  $8.01M   E*, the size that maximises DOLLARS PER YEAR - OPERATE HERE
  $12.54M  the wall - growth reaches zero; an account parked here earns NOTHING

E* is the operating answer, NOT the wall. Past E* each extra dollar earns less than the one
before it; by the wall it earns nothing.

LEVERAGE - A HARD PRACTICAL GATE:
  the 80-concurrent book needs 110:1 GROSS NOTIONAL (0.149% risk/trade, 1.38x equity notional
  per position). EU retail 30:1 and US retail 50:1 CANNOT PLACE IT. Offshore 500:1 can, and
  supports up to ~363 concurrent. Manuel's OctaFX instinct was structurally necessary.

BILLIONS: NOT on five markets. The ceiling is LINEAR IN INSTRUMENT COUNT:
  5 -> $8.01M   10 -> $16.02M   20 -> $32.04M   50 -> $80.11M   100 -> $160.21M
  A billion needs ~80-100 instruments at realistic FX capacity.
  Capacity scales with the COUNT of markets; stake scales with sqrt(N_eff) and saturates at
  1/rho = 13 independent bets. So BREADTH BUYS CEILING FAR FASTER THAN IT BUYS GROWTH RATE.
  That asymmetry is the whole answer.

===============================================================================
4. HARVESTING - MANUEL'S RECYCLING IDEA, PRICED (#486/#487/#488)
===============================================================================
Parking at the ceiling earns zero, so withdrawing is the correct response. Cycle time must be
INTEGRATED (T = INTEGRAL dE/(E*mu(E))), not divided by a single rate.

FIXED RESTART BASES:
  $100    3.12 yrs/cycle   $2.57M/yr    13% of best
  $15k    2.18 yrs         $3.67M/yr    19%
  $31.8k  1.92 yrs         $4.15M/yr    21%
  $1M     0.73 yrs         $9.64M/yr    49%
  $5M     0.17 yrs        $17.66M/yr    90%
  never restart, withdraw continuously  $19.55M/yr   100%

WITHDRAWAL CADENCE MATTERS FAR MORE THAN THE BASE:
  weekly 99% | MONTHLY 97% | quarterly 83% | annually 39%
  Monthly is an ordinary standing bank instruction and captures essentially the maximum.

PROPORTIONAL RECYCLING (keep f x E*, withdraw the rest) - auto-scales as width grows:
  keep 10%  $8.97M/yr   46%
  keep 20% $11.36M/yr   58%
  keep 40% $14.81M/yr   76%   <- Manuel's proposal
  keep 60% $17.40M/yr   89%   <- RECOMMENDED
  keep 80% $18.94M/yr   97%
The 40% rule cycles $3.20M -> $8.01M, 3.1x/yr, withdrawing $4.81M each time, and grows at 97%
of the capacity-free rate because it operates mostly BELOW the erosion point. Raising it to 60%
costs nothing structural and buys $2.6M/yr. Average broker exposure 70% -> 80% of E* is the only
thing given up; PEAK exposure is $8.01M either way.

A PROPORTIONAL RULE FOLLOWS THE CEILING; A DOLLAR RULE DOES NOT. Unchanged at 20 instruments it
gives a $12.82M base and $59.26M/yr; at 100, $64.08M and $296M/yr.

BOTTOM LINE ON BILLIONS: harvesting converts an exponential into a LINEAR accumulation - that is
what withdrawing DOES. $19.55M/yr reaches $1B in ~51 years. It is an INCOME, not a road to a
billion. But it is precisely the income that BUYS THE WIDTH that does get there. Five markets
fund the twenty, the twenty fund the hundred.

===============================================================================
5. SHIPPED TO THE BUILD - WARRANT#489, COMPILED 0 ERRORS / 0 WARNINGS
===============================================================================
  * MAX_SL_DISTANCE_ATR 2.8 -> 6.5. The old clamp sat BELOW the optimum every band measured,
    which made the question untestable from inside the build - calibration can never propose a
    value the clamp forbids. This is the change that actually matters.
  * Confidence bands as RUNNING QUANTILES of the build's own score margin, with a per-band
    TP:SL ratio (1.00 / 0.67 / 0.67 / 0.83 / 0.83). Quantiles not fixed thresholds, because the
    score space has moved twice this campaign and a fixed threshold would silently come to mean
    something else after the next recalibration.
  * Below 60 samples there is NO BAND, not a confident one - the build behaves exactly as before
    until it has evidence. That is the defect class this campaign keeps finding.
  Verified on all four signals: fresh log 686ms, ex4 mtime advanced 10:13:03 -> 11:03:12, ex4
  newer than mq4, bytes 3987530 -> 3986506. Deployed byte-identical to MQL4\Experts.

WHAT I DELIBERATELY DID NOT SHIP: the research's literal SL of 6.0 ATR. It was measured against
the RESEARCH entry rule (EMA-50 side + the ranker); the build enters on unifiedScore. WARRANT#458
established that brackets are NOT neutral conditional on entry, so it does not transfer by
assertion. The STRUCTURE is general, the MAGNITUDES are local, and calibration now has the
headroom to find its own.

CONDITION: the band ratios assume the EA runs on M5. intelligence.atr is iATR(Symbol(),0,14,0)
= PERIOD_CURRENT. On any other timeframe "6.5 ATR" means something different from what I measured.

===============================================================================
6. CORRECTIONS I MADE TO MY OWN WORK THIS SESSION
===============================================================================
  * WARRANT#486's mu(E) curve was Monte Carlo NOISE below the knee ($5M showing 18.83x and
    $7.50M showing 12.16x when both are capacity-free and must be equal). E* was not determined.
    Replaced with the CLOSED FORM - the expected log return needs no sampling at all.
  * WARRANT#487's restart table printed "112% of optimum", which is impossible. Cause: I used the
    CAPACITY-FREE growth rate across a cycle whose final stretch runs above the capacity
    threshold. Reissued as WARRANT#488 with the cycle time integrated.
  This is my most frequent analytical defect and it hit four times today: using a rate measured in
  one regime to describe another. Now saved as a standing check.

===============================================================================
7. THE ONE INPUT I CANNOT MEASURE
===============================================================================
Every ceiling above rests on a $25M-per-position capacity estimate. No .hst file can confirm it.
It is LINEAR in that number:
  $5M/position   -> E* $1.60M,  wall $2.51M
  $25M           -> E* $8.01M,  wall $12.54M    <- what I used
  $100M          -> E* $32.04M, wall $50.18M
  $250M          -> E* $80.11M, wall $125.45M   <- plausible for FX majors
  $1B            -> E* $320M,   wall $502M
I lean toward my estimate being LOW - EURUSD spot turns over ~$1T/day, so a $25M clip is small by
that market's standards. Always quote the sensitivity, never the single cell.

HIGHEST-VALUE DATA THE FIRST LIVE ACCOUNT PRODUCES: fill price vs intended, bucketed by lot size.
That converts this guess into a measurement, and every number above pivots on it. Worth wiring
into the build before scaling.
